5686-7084-8338.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

4613-4644-6218.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4644-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

232-678-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
232-678-7272.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1829-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

997-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
997-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

4399-4770-5468-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5468-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7175-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1368-1563-4885-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4885-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-5929-7297.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4824-5963-7287.description:
Activate Marvin using Transdimensional Bovine's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1274-1308-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-1308-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3470-5478-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

147-6785.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Devastating Onslaught
147-6785.description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {2}{R}, targeting an artifact or creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Devastating Onslaught, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Devastating Onslaught, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-1939-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1939-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-5334-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

617-2440-4024-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Humans.
617-2440-4024-4235.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Horn of Gondor trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of Humans you control.
When the Humans enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve a Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and/or Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Horn of Gondor.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Horn of Gondor.
Repeat.

777-1020-1117-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-2628-2792--100.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2} plus enough mana to cycle both cycling cards.
813-2628-2792--100.description:
Activate up to five lands you control, adding at least {2} plus enough mana to cycle both instant / sorcery cards.
Activate an instant or sorcery's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate an instant or sorcery's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the two cycling cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
813-2628-2792--100.notes: The lands must be able to produce {2} plus enough mana of the appropriate types to cycle both instant / sorcery cards in your hand.

81-1912-2060-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
81-1912-2060-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1432-2085-4639.notablePrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
1432-2085-4639.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

423-3609-4011-5621.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You are able to play a number of lands this turn equal to four minus the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
423-3609-4011-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Evolution Sage trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat from step 1 until Magistrate's Scepter has four or more charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

232-1418-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1506-1605-3059.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Malignus.
Malignus does not have summoning sickness.
1506-1605-3059.description:
Activate Malignus by tapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to twice its power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

1819-3740-4091-4684-5006-5229.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1819-3740-4091-4684-5006-5229.description:
Tap Alphetto Alchemist to untap itself.
Mill 1 with Mesmeric Orb.
Repeat until you mill Nullpriest of Oblivion and Syr Konrad shuffling when you do not mill them using the Titan.
Cast and kick Nullpriest of Oblivion with Lurrus of the Dream-Den, bringing Syr Konrad to the battlefield.
Repeat Milling until you mill the Titan, dealing damage with Syr Konrad.

1525-2396-4179-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1525-2396-4179-4298.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving all creature you control +1/+1, trample, and infect untile end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.
